# PottsChainEntanglementEntropy

Module: **Spin** · directory: `Spin/src/Programs` · binary: `Spin/src/Programs/PottsChainEntanglementEntropy`

```text
PottsChainEntanglementEntropy, version 0.01

Usage: PottsChainEntanglementEntropy [options] 

Options:

system options:
    -n, --zn : Zn value of the Potts model (default value = 3)
    --ground-file : name of the file corresponding to the ground state of the whole system
    --degenerated-groundstate : single column file describing a degenerated ground state
    --min-la : minimum size of the subsystem whose entropy has to be evaluated (default value = 1)
    --max-la : maximum size of the subsystem whose entropy has to be evaluated (0 if equal to half the total system size) (default value = 0)
    --shift-sites : location of the leftmost site that belongs to A (default value = 0)
    --real-vectors : indicates  that the ground state vector is real

parallelization options:
    -S, --SMP : enable SMP mode
    --processors : number of processors to use in SMP mode (default value = 2)
    --smp-profil : enable SMP profiling, the name of the log file  has to be passed as argument

output options:
    -o, --output-file : use this file name instead of the one that can be deduced from the input file name (replacing the vec extension with ent extension)
    --density-matrix : use this file name instead of the one that can be deduced from the input file name (replacing the vec extension with full.ent extension) to store the reduced density matrix spectrum

tools options:
    --use-lapack : use LAPACK libraries instead of DiagHam libraries
    --use-svd : use singular value decomposition instead of diagonalization to compute the entropy
    --diag-precision : convergence precision in non LAPACK mode (default value = 1e-07)

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
